en.headline: sogeisetsu: 25 commits, 23 from github-actions[bot] in sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu
en.summary: The day's work centred on `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, which received **23 own commits**. In that repository the commits fixed provider protocol-id lookups to use own-property access, capped the review budget per page instead of per batch, and added a keyless Google web endpoint as an unverified preset. Further changes introduced Microsoft MT and an optional LLM review pass, and made the page translate the viewport first while capping viewport batches so the first translation lands sooner. Plan documentation recorded acceptance of the Microsoft MT and optional review work, viewport-first acceptance alongside the batch-shape fix, and an assessment of proxy options for Index-Translate by user experience. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` the user made **2 own commits**: one switched the model behind `/oc` and diagnostic narration from longcat to `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`, the other retired the minimax and longcat free legs so the chain became deepseek → sensenova. In addition, **23 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`** were recorded in that same repository. No pull requests, reviews, issues, releases or discussion activity were logged, and no collection section hit its cap.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 共 25 次提交，另有 23 次由 github-actions[bot] 提交
zh.summary: 当天的工作主要集中在 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`，该仓库共 **23 次本人提交**。该仓库的提交修复了 provider 协议 ID 查找改用自有属性访问，将 review 预算改为按页而非按批次限制，并新增了无需密钥的 Google 网页端点作为未验证预设。其他改动引入了 Microsoft MT 和可选的 LLM review 环节，并让页面优先翻译视口区域、限制视口批次，使首次翻译更快完成。计划文档记录了 Microsoft MT 与可选 review 的验收情况、视口优先的验收结果及批次形态修复，还记录了按用户体验评估 Index-Translate 代理选项的内容。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，用户本人提交了 **2 次**：一次将 `/oc` 与诊断叙述所用的模型从 longcat 换成 `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`，另一次下线 minimax 与 longcat 两条免费链路，使调用链变为 deepseek → sensenova。此外，同一仓库还记录了 **23 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 完成的自动提交**。当天没有 pull request、review、issue、release 或讨论活动，各采集部分均未触及上限。
